query:
SELECT amount AS "amount!", created AS "created!", kind AS "kind!", reason AS "reason!", class AS "class?", pretty AS "pretty?", quantity AS "quantity?"
FROM (
    SELECT
        member,
        amount,
        created,
        'deposit' AS kind,
        reason,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS class,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS pretty,
        NULL::INTEGER AS quantity
    FROM gear_bank_deposits

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        target AS member,
        amount,
        created,
        'transfer_in' AS kind,
        reason,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS class,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS pretty,
        NULL::INTEGER AS quantity
    FROM gear_bank_transfers

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        source AS member,
        -amount AS amount,
        created,
        'transfer_out' AS kind,
        reason,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS class,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS pretty,
        NULL::INTEGER AS quantity
    FROM gear_bank_transfers

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        gbp.member,
        (-gbp.personal * gbp.quantity) AS amount,
        gbp.created,
        'purchase' AS kind,
        gbp.reason,
        gbp.class,
        gi.pretty,
        gbp.quantity
    FROM gear_bank_purchases gbp
    LEFT JOIN gear_items gi ON gi.class = gbp.class
) ledger
WHERE member = $1
ORDER BY created DESC;
